components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Neutral Create CTA — Instrument Silver fill, Pit Ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid #c4cdd8; border-radius: 2px; background: #c4cdd8; color: #0b0d10; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0b0d10, 0 0 0 4px #3d8bfd; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default toolbar control — transparent with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn { padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid #252a33; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #d8dde6; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #8b95a5; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0b0d10, 0 0 0 4px #3d8bfd; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Cancel run — coral outline, 12% wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid #e85d5d; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #e85d5d; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #e85d5d 12%, transparent); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0b0d10, 0 0 0 4px #3d8bfd; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Create-form field — Pit Ink well, hairline border, 2px radius.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #8b95a5; } .ds-input { padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #252a33; border-radius: 2px; background: #0b0d10; color: #d8dde6; font: inherit; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #8b95a5; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0b0d10, 0 0 0 4px #3d8bfd; border-color: #252a33; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Uppercase mono status chip; fill is a 20% status wash.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-badge-running { background: color-mix(in srgb, #3d8bfd 20%, transparent); color: #3d8bfd; } .ds-badge-idle { background: #2a303a; color: #8b95a5; }

components.name: Run List Item
components.description: Sidebar run row — mono id, badge meta, selection wash.
components.css: .ds-run-item { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #252a33; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-run-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #d8dde6 4%, transparent); } .ds-run-item-selected { background: color-mix(in srgb, #3d8bfd 12%, transparent); } .ds-run-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0b0d10, 0 0 0 4px #3d8bfd; } .ds-run-id { display: block; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #d8dde6; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-run-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: #8b95a5; } .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-badge-running { background: color-mix(in srgb, #3d8bfd 20%, transparent); color: #3d8bfd; }

components.name: Factory Node
components.description: Pipeline graph node — mono readout; status border; selection ring.
components.css: .ds-factory-node { padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #252a33; border-radius: 2px; background: #12151a; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10px; text-align: center; min-width: 120px; color: #d8dde6; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-factory-node-running { border-color: #3d8bfd; color: #3d8bfd; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, #3d8bfd 25%, transparent); } .ds-factory-node-selected { background: color-mix(in srgb, #3d8bfd 14%, #12151a); border-color: #3d8bfd; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #3d8bfd; } .ds-attempt { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.7; }

narrative.overview:
This is a local operate surface, not a product marketing page. The built UI is a near-black, low-chrome monitor: pipeline state and actions first, surfaces that read as instrument panels rather than cards. IBM Plex Sans carries UI copy; IBM Plex Mono marks the instruments — brand title, section labels, run ids, buttons, badges, graph nodes, and event lines.

Depth comes from tonal stacking (`#0b0d10` field / `#12151a` panels) and 1px `#252a33` borders. Chromatic color is reserved for run and node status. The Create CTA is a neutral cool-gray fill (`#c4cdd8` on `#0b0d10`), not a branded accent splash. Confirmed rejections: SaaS dashboard costume, gradients, card stacks, hero chrome, decorative glow as default elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black clinical field with one surface step up
Dual type: Plex Sans UI + Plex Mono instruments
Status hues only for run/node state (and matching selection)
Dense operate layout: header / create+runs / toolbar+graph+outcome

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Chromatic color is for run/node status (and the matching selection cue). UI chrome, fills, and the primary CTA stay neutral.

rules.name: The Neutral CTA Rule
rules.body: Primary actions use Instrument Silver on Pit Ink — never a saturated brand fill.

rules.name: The Mono Instrument Rule
rules.body: Run ids, node labels, buttons, badges, section titles, and event lines use IBM Plex Mono. Body explanation copy stays on Plex Sans.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce drop shadows for resting chrome. Use tonal steps and 1px borders; rings only for focus, selection, or running pulse.

dos: Do keep chromatic color on status, selection, and danger affordances only.
Do use Instrument Silver for the primary Create action and links.
Do separate zones with 1px Hairline Slate and bg/surface tone steps.
Do put ids, nodes, buttons, and badges on IBM Plex Mono.
Do stack sidebar above graph below 840px with a real scrollable upper band.
donts: Don't costume the console as a SaaS dashboard (card stacks, gradients, hero chrome, purple glow themes).
Don't introduce a saturated brand primary that competes with status blue/green/amber/coral.
Don't add resting drop shadows or large radii; keep the 2px control language.
Don't use display/marketing type scales — this surface has title/body/label/badge only.
